$comment: What's new in Cafe Bazaar for the next version (required: a Bazaar build fails without it). Set version to the version being released (package.json) and write fa and en, on the bazaar branch. Emptied automatically after a release.
fa: ظاهر تازه‌ی پنجره‌ها و دکمه‌ها، گردونه‌ی شانس، شخصی‌سازی قطار و ریل با ستاره، داستان مصور و اجرای سبک‌تر روی گوشی.
en: New look for popups and buttons, a lucky wheel, train and rail colours bought with stars, a comic story and a lighter game on phones.
